WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS store_net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS store_receipts
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS web_orders
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.store_id = 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(st.store_net_sales, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_sales, 0) AS total_net_sales,
    COALESCE(st.store_receipts, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_orders, 0) AS total_transactions,
    ROUND((COALESCE(st.store_net_sales, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_sales, 0)) / 
           (COALESCE(st.store_receipts, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_orders, 0)), 2) AS atv
FROM store_sales st
CROSS JOIN web_sales w

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_breakdown AS (
    SELECT 
        'Store sales' AS channel,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS transactions,
        ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_breakdown AS (
    SELECT 
        'Web orders' AS channel,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS transactions,
        ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id), 2) AS atv
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id = 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
)
SELECT channel, net_sales, transactions, atv FROM store_breakdown
UNION ALL
SELECT channel, net_sales, transactions, atv FROM web_breakdown

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
)
SELECT 
    'Company (all channels)' AS scope,
    'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
    'P1-P3' AS periods,
    ROUND((
        SELECT SUM(f.net_amount)
        FROM fact_sales_line f
        JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
        JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
        JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
        CROSS JOIN params
        WHERE s.store_id < 900
          AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
          AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
          AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
          AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
    ) + COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(f.net_amount)
        FROM fact_sales_line f
        JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
        JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
        JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
        JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
        CROSS JOIN params
        WHERE s.store_id = 900
          AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
          AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
          AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
          AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
          AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
    ), 0)) / ((
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id)
        FROM fact_sales_line f
        JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
        JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
        JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
        CROSS JOIN params
        WHERE s.store_id < 900
          AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
          AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
          AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
          AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
    ) + COALESCE((
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id)
        FROM fact_web_order o
        JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
        CROSS JOIN params
        WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
          AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
          AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
    ), 0)) AS atv

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
),
web_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id = 900
      AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
)
SELECT 
    'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
    1 AS period_from,
    3 AS period_to,
    ROUND((COALESCE((SELECT net_sales FROM store_sales), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT net_sales FROM web_sales), 0)) / 
           (COALESCE((SELECT receipts FROM store_sales), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT orders FROM web_sales), 0)), 2) AS atv
FROM store_sales st
CROSS JOIN web_sales w
LIMIT 1
